title: S. pyogenes 7F7 Cas9 protein + CRISPRCasDB published per-spacer aggregate flanks
claim_scope: retrospective evolutionary evidence; aggregate flanks, not raw target alignments

protein.source: NCBI Datasets RefSeq assembly protein, GCF_000767505.1
protein.license: NCBI molecular data; no NCBI-imposed reuse restrictions (submitter rights may apply)

spacer_orientation.evidence: CRISPRCasDB supplies an explicit per-row orientation field. For this subset every row records orientation_source=orientation_PAMbased, i.e. the published flanks were already oriented using PAM information. The flank columns used are the already-oriented upstream/downstream fields, so no further flipping is applied. Unlike the PAMpredict bundle, this source states its orientation rather than leaving it to be inferred.
spacer_orientation.not_evidence: The oriented_spacer column is the source table's own spacer string; agreement between that column and spacers.fna is verified by the scorer and is not itself an orientation argument.

spacers.source_name: Vink et al. CRISPRCasDB spacer table; CP007240.1 subset

published_flanks.source_name: Vink et al. per-spacer consensus flanks; oriented row subset

protein.license: NCBI molecular data; no NCBI-imposed reuse restrictions

independent_cross_check.what: The 8 spacers in this subset were independently re-derived from the whole genome by the local CCTyper genome-annotation pipeline.
independent_cross_check.result: 8 of 8 spacers match exactly on the same strand; 0 require reverse-complementing.
independent_cross_check.caveat: This artifact is a local run output and is not tracked in Git; it is machine-local corroboration, not a versioned repo fact.

limitations: Published flanks are per-spacer AGGREGATE consensus sequences (23 nt), not raw per-hit alignments.
Raw target contig identifiers are unavailable, so target independence cannot be assessed.
Only 7 of 8 spacers have a non-empty PAM-side flank; the hit=0 row is excluded with its source row id retained.
The protein is a near-exact Protein2PAM training relative and the gold PAM is species-level (canonical SpCas9 NGG), so this is retrospective only.
Aggregate flank evidence is evolutionary, not cleavage activity.
support_target_count is deliberately zero for this evidence class because one consensus flank is not an independent target.
